protocol.timing: synchronous wall time; fused read/sample, separate normalization and augmentation calls
protocol.included: chunk I/O/decode, planning, allocations, sampling, normalization, augmentation; CUDA upload on cache misses
protocol.excluded: input generation, reader/pipeline construction, validation, warmup, cache clearing, output destruction
protocol.caches: host and OS caches are not flushed; warm CUDA cache may evict if its budget is too small
protocol.order: backend order rotates each repetition; identical crops and seeds
protocol.routes: cpu: CPU read/normalize/augment; cuda: device chunks; hybrid: CPU read/sample + upload, CUDA normalize/augment
protocol.hybrid_upload: box: uint8 crop uploaded then cast on GPU; affine: CPU-sampled float32 crop uploaded
protocol.throughput: output voxels and float32 output bytes, not storage or PCIe bandwidth
protocol.speedup: CPU / CUDA p50 latency; >1 means CUDA is faster
